# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Follow root `AGENTS.md` as the canonical working agreement.

Before material work, read:
- `docs/PROJECT-MEMORY.md`
- `docs/CURRENT-HANDOFF.md`
- one applicable `.agents/superpowers/` workflow or `.agents/skills/` procedure

Do not preload the full catalog. Load `docs/AGENT-PLATFORM-WORKFLOWS.md` only for host/onboarding work and `docs/MCP-SETUP.md` only for external-system work.

Use GitHub checks, tests and source as evidence. Do not treat generated code as reviewed merely because an AI agent authored it.
